title: Case 031: Plumbing request
initial_request: The toilet cistern keeps filling with water and never stops. I have received a letter from Oakfield Services about a water leakage over two weeks ago.
overview: The tenant reported a toilet cistern that would not stop filling and a water-leakage letter received more than two weeks earlier. Landlord approval was confirmed and a maintenance provider was assigned. The provider and tenant arranged a visit; the tenant said the plumbing team could attend while they were away. The provider later indicated the job was done and was waiting on an invoice. An invoice was reported as attached and later uploaded, but its contents are unavailable. The provider requested closure, saying the work was completed on 17 April (synthetic date: 26 July). After final checks, the request was marked completed and closed. A document-upload step was skipped because no other documents were required; the record also notes that landlord confirmation was needed.
outcome: The provider confirmed the cistern repair was completed and uploaded an invoice. The request was closed after final checks.
